title: Diagnose why public Delete lost an active changed child's trace in C1 (now passing without an isolated cause)
outcome: The cause of the C1 failure of tests::engram_host_adapter::turn_observations::public_delete_keeps_an_actual_changed_child_until_its_ordinary_report_is_settled is identified from source and evidence: product race, test or fixture defect, or environment. acceptance: Diagnose why public Delete lost an active changed child's trace in C1 (now passing without an isolated cause) is done
disposal_reason: Resolved by diagnosis, not a defect (Opus3, notes f685fb19/cbe6efec on w-79cb2894b78f). C1's failing assertion (:222) checked the trace AFTER load_state. Boot recovery deliberately moves an active trace into the "host restarted" recovery notice: persisted_state.rs:410 → :638 recover_interrupted_sessions → messages.rs:200 unadmitted_active_turn.take(). Master's port reads the durable sqlite row first (:494-510), then asserts is_none() plus the notice (:516). No trace was lost; the old test expectation was wrong, so the pass on master is explained.
